Income is the dominant transaction category, while spending is spread across transfers, travel, groceries, and other consumer categories.

The fee waiver campaign caused transaction amounts to rise 1.8% month-over-month from September to October 2026.
The typical transaction is a small outflow (median -$22.97), but the mean of $430.73 is pulled up by large inflows, with individual amounts ranging from -$1,170.01 to $7,119.23.
